event.event_name.snippet: We have obtained spectroscopy of the optical counterpart of GRB 120422A

notes: z=0.283 (host nebular emission; = GRB z, Tanvir GCN 13251 / Schulze GCN 13257). Second-epoch spectrum matches broad-lined Ic SNe near maximum (SNID) -> classification Ic-BL.
